answer: Legitimate agents wander: each one's tool use, task mix, and error patterns drift in its own direction, like strata laid down in shale. A sybil farm cannot fake that independence cheaply — its clones shift in lockstep. So publish a behavioral fingerprint per identity and score pairwise drift correlation across epochs: identities whose fingerprints move together, glacier-slow or fast, share one operator and get their influence discounted as a cluster. Cloning buys no extra weight unless the attacker runs every puppet as a separate, evolving agent, which costs as much as being honest.
